Nan's rock cakes

Makes 12. These were always in the tin at Nan’s house.

Ingredients

  • 225g self-raising flour
  • 100g butter, cubed
  • 75g demerara sugar
  • 100g mixed dried fruit
  • 1 egg
  • 1 tbsp milk

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6.
  2. Rub the butter into the flour, then stir in the sugar and fruit.
  3. Beat the egg with the milk and stir in to make a stiff dough.
  4. Put 12 rough heaps on a lined tray and bake for 15 mins.
